tasks.label: Validate PowerShell syntax
args: $files = Get-ChildItem -File -Filter '*.ps1' -Recurse; foreach ($file in $files) { $tokens = $null; $errors = $null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($file.FullName, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors); if ($errors.Count -gt 0) { $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Error ($file.FullName + ': ' + $_.Message) } } }; if ($Error.Count -gt 0) { exit 1 }
